name: xargs
summary: Build and execute commands from standard input.
description: Constructs command lines from items read from standard input, with controls for batching and placement.

options.description: Use at most MAX-ARGS input items per command line.

examples.title: Run a command for each item
examples.explanation: Builds one printf invocation per input item.

examples.title: Handle filenames safely
examples.explanation: Uses NUL delimiters so spaces do not split names.

examples.title: Pass many arguments in batches
examples.explanation: Limits each invocation to two input arguments.
